        if not self.dynamic: return self.template

        out = bytearray(self.template)

new_machine = '''class MachineModel(object):
    """Recorded state machine plus its compiled transition guards.

    Guards are evaluated on the recovered entry inputs of one record, so all
    guards of a campaign share a single environment holder: it is repointed at

    Guard predicates that read no variable are folded once, which keeps a
    guard-heavy machine cheap even for thousands of records.
